answer_1.quote: We also successfully apply BALM in bilingual lexicon induction, and language normalization tasks to validate the idea.
answer_1.outputs: The model can generate normalized sentences from code-switched input, generate code-switched sentences, and translate between languages.

answer_2.quote: We conduct a series of experiments, namely BALM, Synthetic CS, CS-Only, and Mono, using the same BALM network architecture to evaluate different modeling strategies.
